intro_section.intro_text: The Weber Collection was a recipe video series showcasing the versatility of barbecue cooking through a variety of dishes and techniques. Combining cinematic food visuals with clear step by step instructions, the videos were designed to inspire viewers while teaching practical barbecue recipes, ingredients, and cooking methods.

projects.title: The Apex Series Reveal
projects.description: A high-energy 60s spot for the flagship product. I handled the offline edit and coordinated with the VFX team for the HUD overlays. The goal was speed and precision.

projects.title: Life at Vertex
